question: Which of the following river is known as Ponnani in Kerla and has a total drainage area of the basin as 6,186 sq. km?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharathappuzha**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharathappuzha **is known as **Ponnani in Kerla** and has a total drainage area of the basin of 6,186 sq.km.
 
• The Bharathappuzha is the second-longest river in Kerala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Periyar River is the longest river in Kerala.
 
• The origin of the Periyar river is believed to be from the Sivagiri hills of the Western Ghats.
 
• It falls in the Arabian Sea, covering a distance of 230 km.
 
• The Idukki dam on this river is the major source of power supply in the province of Kerala.
 
• The 'Periyar Hydroelectric Project' is located on it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Achankovil **is a 128 km long west flowing river in Kerala, India.

 
 
• It flows through Kollam, Pathanamthitta, and Alappuzha districts.
 
 
 
• **Ayiroor **is on the banks of the river Ayiroorpuzha.
 
 
• It is one of the smallest rivers in Kerala after **Manjeshwaram puzha. **
 
 
 
• **Ithikkara River** is a 56 km long river in Kerala, India.
 
 
• It originates in the Kulathupuzha in the Western Ghats and flows through the Kollam district, finally emptying into Paravur Lake
